scope: Matched long proof regions; two independent works, one edition per work; not a statistical test of quality or authorship. Full-document measurements are additional context.
corpus_name: Algebraic PCP and low-degree testing: extended proof regions, TeX sources

ai_lexicon_rate.desc: AI-lexicon words (delve, leverage, robust, notably, crucial, landscape, ...) per 1000 words

apparatus_rate.desc: repository apparatus in prose (inline code, hex hashes, bare URLs, shell commands, SHA-256 mentions) per 1000 words

connective_open_share.desc: share of sentences opening with a discourse connective (Thus, Hence, Then, Indeed, Moreover, However, In particular, ...)

contrast_rate.desc: contrastive framing ('not X, but Y', 'X, not Y', 'rather than', 'instead of') per 1000 words

en_dash_rate.desc: spaced en dashes used as dashes per 1000 words

hedge_rate.desc: boundary disclaimers ('does not establish', 'remains open', 'no claim', ...) per 1000 words

intensifier_rate.desc: intensifiers (precisely, exactly, genuinely, directly, explicitly, ...) per 1000 words

let_open_share.desc: share of sentences opening with Let/Suppose/Fix/Assume/Consider

meta_narration_rate.desc: meta-narration ('Here is', 'The point is', 'The key idea', 'Crucially', 'Importantly', 'This section ...', 'The mechanism', 'The hard step', ...) per 1000 words

negation_rate.desc: negations (not, no, never, none, cannot, without, n't) per 1000 words

para_len_cv.desc: coefficient of variation of paragraph length

para_summary_end_share.desc: share of paragraphs (>= 3 sentences) whose last sentence opens with Thus/Hence/So/Therefore/In short/...

passive_share.desc: share of sentences with a passive construction (proxy)

question_share.desc: share of sentences that are questions

same_opener_share.desc: share of sentences opening with the same word as the previous sentence

sent_len_cv.desc: coefficient of variation of sentence length (sd/mean)

sent_len_mean.desc: mean sentence length in tokens (math placeholder = 1 token)

status_vocab_rate.desc: workflow/status words (Lean, Comparator, receipt, formal, checked, verified, record, ledger, pipeline, evidence class) per 1000 words

this_open_share.desc: share of sentences opening with This/These/That/Those

triad_rate.desc: rule-of-three lists 'A, B, and C' per 1000 words

after.manuscript: Long proof body after revision and bounded citation repair

privacy: Numerical features and manuscript identifiers only; specimen text and reference-corpus passages omitted.
